answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 8931 Country: India Title: Hazrat is working at night allowed? For example if a person has alot of family pressure to support his family financilly and he gets good salary package or more money if he works at night instead of working in the day. What one should do in this case please suggest? Question: Assalamo alikum warahmatulahi wa barkatahu!! Hazrat is working at night allowed? For example if a person has alot of family pressure to support his family financilly and he gets good salary package or more money if he works at night instead of working in the day. What one should do in this case please suggest? Answer ID: 8931 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1138/1138=M/1429) You can work in night if your health allows, there is no prohibition from the Shariah. However, you should be mindful of salah and the rights of your spouse. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
